_about: Per-account token values for the org health masters in this directory. Values were extracted verbatim from each account's .github on 2026-10-01, so bespoke paragraphs live here rather than in the masters. The security values were re-cut on 2026-10-01 for the org policy master (5/15/30 targets, 90-day disclosure): SUBJECT/SCOPE now name the account, EXTRA closes the Scope section, CHANNEL_EXTRA follows the private-reporting paragraph; ichava adopted the master that day. "keep" = the account's own file is the source and is never rendered; "none" = the account carries no such file by design. Client-owned accounts must never appear here.

support.HELP:
Thanks for using a Simtabi open source project. Here is how to get help, fastest
first:

1. **Issues** — for bugs and feature requests, open an issue on the relevant
   repository, if you have access to it.
2. **Email** — [opensource@simtabi.com](mailto:opensource@simtabi.com) for
   anything else, including access questions.

Mukora repositories are private while the interfaces settle, so most support runs
through your usual contact rather than a public tracker.
